parent.model: NativeFactualHybridStream unchanged, P50 original model.py unchanged

hypothesis: A continuously learned contradiction gate mixing the latest actually executed opposite-action causal contrast with the native P50 factorized learned effect improves rapidly changing causal-world transfer versus original P52 and a fully trained GRU and honestly strong recent-factual-effect controls, without claiming hidden switch oracle or performance from pure source generation.

source.source_birth: fresh authored physical-action simulator distinct from P51/P52 seed and distribution
source.executed_action: independent fair +/-1, no forced alternating schedule, no future effects passed to model
source.switch_step: uniform integer [3,5] for switched worlds; no announcement to model
source.nuisance: quadratic polynomial + sinusoid; OOD changes frequency and amplitude
source.training_supervision: one actually executed factual query action/outcome only
source.test_label: both +/-1 alternative potential outcomes generated only for evaluation and never used by optimizer
source.strong_info: all arms see precisely same 8 completed actual factual histories, 1 factual query action and its actual outcome
source.freshness: all P47-P52 evaluation source seeds excluded from newly born source

mechanism.factual_contrast: latest actually observed opposite-action pair, effect=(delta_last-delta_opposite)/(action_last-action_opposite); reject histories lacking an opposite action, no invented effect
mechanism.gate: sigmoid(w0 + w1*abs(learned_effect - observed_contrast) + w2*(elapsed_gap / 8)), three learned scalar parameters
mechanism.wrong_credit: history action-field identity cyclically shifted ONLY for trained wrong-credit arm; factual outcomes unchanged, no hidden source truth
mechanism.update: fast evidence recomputed from completed past facts per query, never committed by hypothetical previews
mechanism.parameter_cap: P53 additional parameters exactly 3 beyond P52
mechanism.cold_restore: exact model weights and factual tensor memory after episode checkpoint
mechanism.known_limitation: nuisance drift biases nearest contrast; switch between chosen observations biases fast evidence; ordinary last-effect and nearest-opposite controls may dominate

stop: Do not adjust seeds, budgets, source, controls, frozen thresholds or choose better result after seeing evaluation. Preserve failure and no-seeming evidence if strong controls beat P53.
